title: ID0446233-DC/Si-D/EE-[MP/P9 170000985] Touch Screen Issue
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Touch not working on screen. Customer tried it on site while I was connected with ssh and looked at the screen. Also checked USB connection and it looked okay.
Solution: Replace HMI

Quick question from my side, the screen was not recognizing the touch at all or was it somewhat taking longer time or even showing the press in another part of the HMI?
Since you already checked the USB cable I don't much better option than to replace the cable.
The 24V supply shouldn't be a problem since the screen is visible.
Let me know your feedback before the recommendation.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
